title: README++: Benchmarking Multilingual Language Models for Multi-Domain Readability Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking and comparing the performance (using Pearson correlation and F1 scores) of various supervised, unsupervised, and few-shot language models on readability assessment tasks across five different languages (Arabic, English, French, Hindi, and Russian), including an analysis of performance disparities and degradation in languages with non-Latin scripts due to transliterated words.
